reason: Hypothesis A proposes a well-established aluminide coating approach that directly addresses oxygen resistance in refractory high-entropy alloys, with a clear mechanism (alumina scale formation) and a specific, testable falsification experiment. Hypothesis B relies on fluorine ion implantation, which is less proven for this alloy class, cites evidence from a different material system (TiAl), and includes an unjustified precise prediction (60% reduction) without strong grounding.
